_readme: THE GOLDEN TIMING SHEET — the one the scene run by hand on 2026-09-18 evening was cut against: one voice paragraph of 8.92 s and the four beat windows read off it. That call came back right (9 s, line check 100%), so these four spans are what the assembled timeline is held to.
The account ids it carried — the voice id and the request id — are replaced by invented ones, because a fixture never carries a real account's identifiers. Nothing else is changed.

Shape: the per-scene sheet a voice run writes. The same four windows appear in vo-timing.json, which is the whole-piece shape machine/voice.py writes to <run>/vo/timing.json; this file is what the golden test asserts the timeline against.
